title: Safety Template
description: A schema for defining content safety constraints, restricted claims, and remediation instructions.

forbidden_phrases.description: Specific words or sequences of words that must never be used.

forbidden_claims.description: Statements, promises, or assertions that are legally or ethically prohibited (e.g., medical advice, guaranteed returns).

risk_triggers.description: Signals or contexts that indicate a high-risk situation requiring caution or intervention.

rewrite_instructions.description: Standardized instructions on how to transform unsafe or restricted content into a compliant version.
